direction-type.words: A Stroll in the Park: Song 1
One day, two boys and a girl, named Jack, John,and Emily were strolling in the park, thinking about how they had recently lost their friend.
A Stroll in the Park: Song 2
Seeing the children playing in the park makes their moods lift a little, making them walk at a faster pace.
A Stroll in the Park: Song 3
Things don't seem so bad after all when they hear the sounds of bird chirping and kids playing in the park.
A Stroll in the Park: Song 4
Dusk starts to break and they again think about their lost friend.
The three children get lost in the park at night, and start to feel a feeling of fright.
Not knowing which way to go, they start to lose hope.
Deciding to rest, they start to see the trace of sunrise, when they suddenly a fiery portal appears out of nowhere.
When a portal suddenly appears, the three children are astonished.
The portal sucks them into a mysterious land, covered with fire, lava, streching into the unknown.
